# Tiny A

Tiny A is a miniature RayuCode document used by the foundation tests. It covers installation, authentication, and a very small amount of troubleshooting.

title: Tiny A
heading: Install
text:
## Install

Install the CLI with one command. The installer downloads a signed binary and puts it on your PATH.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://rayucode.com/install.sh | sh
```

After installation, run `rayu --version` to confirm the binary is available.

# Tiny B

Tiny B is the second miniature document. It describes models, credits, and rate-limiting behaviour for the foundation tests.

title: Tiny B
heading: Rate limits
text:
## Rate limits

The gateway returns HTTP 429 when a client exceeds its window budget. Back off and retry later. A server-side key such as `rayu_sk_live_test` still obeys the same limits.

```text
retry-after: 30
```
